sources.finding: Application data lives in the persistent volume; back up before updates and regularly; restore is performed with the application stopped.
The official Compose example mounts a named volume at /app/backend/data.
Named-volume content survives container removal and Docker documents backup/restore through a helper container.
Compose top-level volumes define reusable persistent storage.
The Online Backup API produces a consistent snapshot of a live SQLite database.
An uncontrolled file copy during a transaction can be inconsistent; use the backup API, VACUUM INTO, or a quiescent copy.

decision: Use existing openwebui_data and Broker ArtifactStore; use coordinated SQLite backup plus immutable referenced payloads or a cold volume snapshot; do not use uncontrolled cp.
